blocks.text: Candy Pangilinan offered words of encouragement to a fellow mother who opened up about feeling “exhausted” while raising her child who’s on the autism spectrum. The celebrity mom, whose 22-year-old son Quentin is also diagnosed with autism, reached out to a netizen who spoke about her circumstance through a post on Threads on Sunday, Sept. 20. “Mahal na mahal ko anak ko pero napapagod na ako bilang nanay niya. Sobrang hirap. Hindi ko alam kailan magiging ok at madali pero ubos na ubos na ko,” the Threads user lamented. “Hinding hindi nila ako maiintidihan hanggang wala silang anak na may autism!” […]...
